texts: h1 room.latest: Return the newest reading: seq, time in ms, temperature, heater.
h1 room.read: Return the readings from_seq to from_seq + count - 1. The output stops at the size limit and says so.
h1 room.record: Record the readings from_seq to from_seq + count - 1 as a window handle. A window never changes.
h1 room.readings: Stream each new reading as it comes.
h1 room.heater: Switch the heater of the room on or off. This changes the room. (ACTION: it needs a confirmation)
step_done: the results show that the current intent is met. Go to the next intent.
wait: a job, a stream or a response is not ready. Wait a short time, then look again.
wake_agent: return to the main agent. The plan cannot continue as it is: the main agent must make a new plan.
abort: stop the run now. To continue can do harm.
